title: Probabilistic failure simulator for GPU pool and dependency SLO validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build and run a probabilistic fault injection harness that simulates staggered regional degradation, GPU pool exhaustion, and dependency blackholes to validate end-to-end SLOs, circuit breaker behavior, and load-shedding policies. This work is intended to stress realistic traffic patterns and surface gaps in routing/fallback logic, autoscaling, and the Console's SLO dashboards. The harness must be safe to run in staging and optionally in a controlled production shadow environment behind feature flags.
goals: Validate that 99th and 95th latency SLOs are preserved within defined degradation envelopes when a single region loses 30-50% GPU capacity
Confirm automatic circuit breaker tripping and graceful load shedding occur at configured thresholds without cascading failures across regions
Measure time-to-recovery for KV cache warming and model warm starts after GPU pool replenishment
Exercise fallback routing to secondary model variants and quantify quality delta under load
acceptance_criteria: Create a reusable harness that can run probabilistic injections: per-request probability, time-windowed bursts, and correlated multi-region events
Run three end-to-end scenarios in staging with synthetic and replayed production workloads and publish metrics: success ratios, p50/p95/p99 latency, qp95 cost per token, CPU/GPU saturation
No customer-facing endpoints in production should observe >=5% additional errors during controlled production shadow run; abort if exceeded
Circuit breaker policies (latency and error-based) activate and anneal according to config; documented in Console with example traces
Post-run analysis and runbook updates merged into docs and linked in the ticket
testing_steps: 1) Build synthetic workload generator that can replay sampled traces from staging traffic and inject request metadata (region, model, seq_len)
2) Implement probabilistic injector service that can simulate: (a) GPU eviction on pool nodes, (b) network blackhole to dependent services (model store, KMS), (c) delayed control-plane responses
3) Add guardrail feature flag and kill-switch to abort the experiment from Console and Slack alerting
4) Run baseline job to capture steady-state SLOs and resource utilization for 24h

5) Execute staggered experiments: (A) single-region 40% GPU capacity drop for 20m; (B) two-region correlated 20% drop for 30m with dependency blackhole on model-store in primary region; (C) burst exhaustion: synthetic tenant traffic spike to 4x sustained QPS with gradual shedding thresholds
6) Collect traces, kernel-level GPU metrics, autoscaler decisions, and rollout/fallback events into a dedicated Grafana dashboard
7) Validate circuit breaker counts, fallback invocations, and client-visible error rates against acceptance thresholds
8) Run a controlled production shadow (optional) for 60m behind feature flag; monitoring team to observe and abort on any anomaly
9) Postmortem with actionable remediation items including tuning recommendations for batching, cache TTLs, and circuit breaker thresholds
metrics_to_collect: circuit breaker open/close counts and durations
fallback routing count and latency to fallback model variants
GPU utilization per-node and per-pool, queue lengths, and OOM/preempt events
cache hit-rate (KV/prefix) and cold-start token overhead
rollback_plan: If customer-facing errors exceed 5% above baseline or critical SLOs degrade for >5min, abort using the experiment kill-switch which reverses injected faults and triggers a forced fallback to healthy pools. If autoscaler behaves unexpectedly, manually scale up dedicated pools and enable emergency routing to pre-warmed fallback region. Document steps and contact on-call infra and SRE. All rollback steps must be executable via Console and have a Slack escalation path.
safety_and_guardrails: Run in staging by default. Any production shadow must be behind a feature flag and limited to non-billing traffic.
Pre-check: no active incidents and SLOs within 1% of baseline for prior 12h
Abort threshold: >5% customer-visible error increase or >10% sustained p99 latency increase
Manual override to pause individual injectors without aborting the entire run
Integration with PagerDuty and #reliability-alerts channel for immediate attention
observability_and_artifacts: Tempo traces: tag experiments with trace_id prefix 'eng-27641'
Post-run notebook for statistical analysis (link in docs)
